AboutPosts

Hi there! I’m Ananya. I’m an aspiring scientist who’s currently studying at Newton South High School. I’m a coder, an artist, and a debater, and you’ve stumbled upon my personal blog.

Some fun facts about me:

  • I like playing tetris
  • I’m being Sunset Shimmer for Halloween (very excited)
  • I’m desi

This entire website is written inside of jekyll, a static site generator created in Ruby, and I designed the CSS off of minima.

The posts here are going to talk about all kinds of things, whether it be biochemistry, or social science, or writing, or any of the other things that might pique my mind or your interest on any given day.

I started it over the summer, so that I’d have a place to put my thoughts and make them pretty for you all to read :)

It’s all fun times over here at the curio shop.

Step right in, and enjoy!
